The '''Kintan Arena''' was a gladiatorial arena located in the [[Nikto Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Kintan Kings]] and their leader, [[the Mountain]], used the arena as their base.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kintan Arena appears in the Republic mission "Strike the Mountain Asunder" on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
